# Malcolm X Official Website

> > The official website documenting the life, legacy, and teachings of Malcolm X, civil rights leader and Nation of Islam minister.

This site provides comprehensive information about Malcolm X (born Malcolm Little in Omaha, Nebraska), including his biography, achievements with the Nation of Islam and founding of the Organization of Afro-American Unity (OAAU), influential quotes, and historical timeline from his early life through his 1965 assassination.

## Key Topics

- Malcolm X
- Nation of Islam (NOI)
- Civil Rights Movement
- African-American History
- Elijah Muhammad
- Organization of Afro-American Unity (OAAU)
- Muslim Mosque, Inc.
- Marcus Garvey Movement
- Black Nationalism
- Religious Conversion
- Activism and Philosophy
- Malcolm Little
- Assassination (1965)
- Harlem and Detroit Ministry

## Life and Legacy

- [Malcolm X – The Official Website of Malcolm X](https://www.malcolmx.com): Official homepage for civil rights leader Malcolm X
- [Biography](https://www.malcolmx.com/biography): Life story of Malcolm X from Omaha to Marcus Garvey Movement influence
- [Achievements](https://www.malcolmx.com/achievements): Key accomplishments including Nation of Islam ministry and OAAU founding
- [Eulogy](https://www.malcolmx.com/eulogy): Ossie Davis's funeral speech at Faith Temple Church in Harlem

## Reference and Resources

- [Chronology](https://www.malcolmx.com/chronology): Timeline of Malcolm X's life from birth in Omaha to assassination
- [Quotes](https://www.malcolmx.com/quotes): Collection of Malcolm X quotes on civil rights, freedom, and philosophy
